description:
Use this when the user asks to add, watch or track Indian stocks in their DalalOS watchlist. Changes only the user's own saved list.

`symbols` is a list or one string, and may be a pasted list separated by commas, semicolons, new lines, tabs or pipes (not spaces), up to 200 entries. Each entry may be an NSE symbol, ISIN, BSE code or company name, and is saved only when it identifies one NSE-listed company exactly. A misspelt or partial name is not saved: it comes back in `ambiguous` with the candidates, to confirm with the user. Returns `watchlist` (the entries saved by this call, including any already on the list), `unmatched` and `ambiguous`. Needs a signed-in DalalOS account.

symbols.description: List of NSE symbols, ISINs, BSE codes or company names, or one pasted string of them. Always send it as `symbols`.
symbols.title: Symbols
